| `PATCH /tasks/:id` | change `title`, `priority`, `assignee_id` or `due_date`; same rules as on create |
| `DELETE /tasks/:id` | delete a task; only admins of the task's project; `204`, `403` for anyone else, `404` if it does not exist |

## Roles
Each project has members with the role `admin` or `member` (table `project_members`). The project owner
becomes its first admin. Deleting tasks needs the `admin` role in the task's project.
